summary.text: Frank Ciccone is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 7 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A field representative for the Rhode Island Laborers District Council, he has served in the Senate since 2003.

paragraphs.text: Frank Ciccone received his diploma from Hope High School and attended Bryant College in 1974.
His professional experience includes working as a field representative for the Rhode Island Laborers District Council.
Ciccone assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate in 2003, and his current term ends on January 5, 2027.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Senate Labor Committee and a member of the Senate Finance Committee and the Rules, Government Ethics and Oversight Committee.
Ciccone is also Senate Majority Leader, according to the Ballotpedia page on the 2026 Senate elections.
